name: mywallet
author: Alejandro Castro
description: MyWallet - Administración de finanzas personales (escritorio Electron + React + Express + SQLite)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build:server: npm run typecheck -w server && node scripts/build-desktop.cjs --server
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:electron
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT,ELECTRON -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/health http://localhost:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env MYWALLET_DEV=1 electron ."
